name: CupertinoAlertDialog
description: An iOS-style alert dialog that informs the user about situations requiring acknowledgment. It can display a title, content, and a list of actions (buttons).

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the alert dialog displayed in a larger font at the top.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The message or main body of the alert dialog, displayed under the title.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The set of actions (buttons) displayed at the bottom of the dialog.
properties.possible_values: List of CupertinoDialogAction or custom widgets.

properties.name: scrollController
properties.description: Controller for scrolling the content if it overflows vertically.

properties.name: actionScrollController
properties.description: Controller for scrolling the actions section if actions overflow.

properties.name: insetAnimationDuration
properties.description: The duration of the dialog's inset animation.

properties.name: insetAnimationCurve
properties.description: The curve used for the inset animation.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
